messages:
olivia: quick sync — thinking through forms validation patterns for the Console. two fast questions: (1) required-field indicator: red dot vs asterisk vs explicit 'Required' label; (2) error presentation: inline field-level errors while typing vs show a summary on submit (or both?). also need a pattern for destructive confirmations (modal with typed-confirm vs inline confirm checkbox). screenshot/proto: https://figma.com/file/xyz

matt: leaning inline errors + summary on submit for long forms. inline helps discoverability as users fill, summary catches anything missed on submit. keep inline terse: one sentence and link to help if needed. aria-live for inline errors.

sanjay: agree with inline first. accessibility notes: move focus to first invalid field on submit, ensure `role="alert"` or `aria-live="assertive"` for error text, and provide `aria-describedby` from input -> error text. summary should have `aria-labelledby` and keyboard-focusable skip link to errors. also, for destructive flows — typed-confirm OK but add option for screen-reader friendly alternative (e.g., visible label that can be focused). @olivia

elaine: design nit — a red dot alone is ambiguous (looks like status). prefer a small asterisk visually + invisible text `Required` for screen readers, or label `Email (required)` when space allows. For inline errors: show them after field on blur/change. For summary: show a compact toast-like banner with a list of fields that failed, each item links back to field. Example microcopy: `Please fix 2 errors to continue.` and inline: `Enter a valid email address.`

alex: from PM perspective — simpler copy reduces support. For destructive actions prefer modal + typed-confirm when deletion has irreversible data. For quick toggles (e.g., reset counters) a lower friction confirmation (secondary inline checkbox) is fine. Copy suggestion for modal: Title: `Delete deployment? This cannot be undone.` Body: `Type the deployment name to confirm.` Primary btn: `Delete deployment`, secondary: `Cancel`.

a11y-bot: automated scan: 2 issues found in proto link — (1) missing `aria-describedby` on #email, (2) insufficient contrast for red-dot-only indicator on #name.

matt: +1 to pairing inline errors with summary. small UX point: avoid duplicating long error copy in both inline + summary — summary can echo the high-level label and link to inline for details.

elaine: suggestion — add a gentle inline affordance for required fields on focus: show `Required` below placeholder as subdued text. reduces need for legend.

olivia: consensus forming: implement inline errors (aria-live, focus on first error), show submission summary for multi-step/long forms, use asterisk visually + `Required` text for sr-only or inline when space allows; destructive = modal typed-confirm for irreversible deletes, inline checkbox for low-risk ops. next steps: I can update the Patterns doc and ship a quick prototype for a11y/usability testing. who wants to pair on the prototype?

sanjay: I can help wire the focus management and aria attributes this afternoon.

matt: I can draft the microcopy and tests.

olivia: awesome — i'll add tasks to the sprint and update the design doc. thanks everyone :tada:
